summary: Iteration 9 — Verified the three Expo Go bug fixes via static grep + web preview + backend pytest. (1) `grep -rn absoluteFillObject /app/frontend/app /app/frontend/src` returned zero matches. (2) Inspected every `useAnimatedStyle`/`useAnimatedProps` worklet body in reader-cover-backdrop.tsx, reader-section.tsx, reader-header.tsx and app/deep-dive/[id].tsx — all worklets only use `interpolate`, `Extrapolation.CLAMP`, math and SharedValue reads; no `withAlpha(`, no theme-color string building or other non-worklet JS call inside a worklet callback. end-action-button.tsx pre-computes `accentBorder`/`accentBg` on JS thread (already noted in-code). (3) Onboarding topics screen at 390×844 shows 13 category tiles, every `category-art-*-image` node has non-zero bounding box (12× 94×94 tiles + `category-art-all-image` 106×106, artwork container fills the tile). (4) Reader `/deep-dive/why-we-yawn` renders and scrolls with only harmless Reanimated/textShadow/pointerEvents web deprecation warnings; no Worklets/Remote Function errors. (5) Info grid measured: `story-info-grid-kind-icon` 44×44, `story-info-grid-category-icon` 44×44, `story-info-grid-time-icon` 46×46 — visually equal weight. (6) Backend `GET /api/category-media/corpo-umano?cutout=true` returns 200 image/png, exactly 320×320 RGBA, all four corners alpha=0, and alpha bounding-box height 262 (≥ 192 = 60% of 320). No blockers found.
